title: Two Dogs Whine
specs: Award-winning Chardonnay, Riesling, Malbec, and Sangiovese wines.
Small-batch fermentations and attentive barrel aging using French and American oak.
Wines sourced from grapes and juices from Chile, Italy, and other global regions.
gap: Price per bottle or tasting not stated
blurb: Two Dogs Whine is a family-run micro-winery founded by John and Julie Edgar in King George, VA. They craft wines using grapes and juices sourced worldwide, employing small-batch fermentations and barrel aging. Their offerings include award-winning Chardonnay, Riesling, Malbec, Sangiovese, and various sweet wines like Pink Moscato and Blackberry Wine.
